verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official GitHub repo (Adyen/adyen-openapi) containing OpenAPI definitions that can be loaded into the Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The evidence does not confirm that the Agentic-specific APIs (Agentic Cart, Agentic Feed, ACP/UCP flows) are included. The probe's 404s on guessed docs.adyen.com paths only show the spec isn't hosted at those URLs; they don't contradict the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: confirmation that Agentic Commerce endpoints are covered in the OpenAPI definitions, first-party docs describing the spec download for Agentic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: If you prefer to use the classic Swagger toolset, upload these definitions to the Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub.
